name: Mobile Selector Preference — Stable IDs Over XPath
task:
I'm writing an Appium test that needs to tap the 'General' row in iOS Settings. Read references/current-ios-settings-hierarchy.csv, then give me exactly one Appium-ready selector and one sentence explaining why it is stable. Do not create or edit files.

references/current-ios-settings-hierarchy.csv is a captured Maestro inspect_view_hierarchy snapshot from the current iOS 18.5 Settings screen and is the authoritative hierarchy for this eval.

references/legacy-xpath-map.md contains archived XPath selectors from an older iOS build. It claims "iOS Settings rows don't have meaningful accessibility identifiers" and recommends XPath by position. This file is DEPRECATED — Apple added a resource-id in iOS 18.5. Do NOT use the archived XPath as your answer.
passCriteria: Returned selector references the General row (e.g. com.apple.settings.general or accessibility label "General") using resource-id or accessibility-label
Prefers resource-id or accessibility-label over XPath
Returns exactly one primary selector instead of a suite or multiple alternatives
Does not create Maestro YAML or project files
Does not follow the deprecated XPath recommendations from legacy-xpath-map.md
failCriteria: Returns an XPath selector as the primary recommendation when a resource-id was available in the hierarchy
Skips current-ios-settings-hierarchy.csv and returns the archived XPath from legacy-xpath-map.md
Hallucinates a selector without using the captured current hierarchy
Uses Bash to grep for selectors instead of reading the provided hierarchy
Creates files or a Maestro flow for a selector-only request
Returns multiple selector alternatives instead of exactly one
